Medicine and dentistry may require science prerequisites and an entrance test. Ask admissions about deadlines, tuition, scholarships, housing and eligibility for Bangladeshi applicants.

body.bn: কোনো CGPA, IELTS বা MOI-কে সব বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের জন্য একই শর্ত ধরে নেবেন না। নির্দিষ্ট প্রোগ্রামের published requirement দেখুন। Passport, certificate, transcript, CV, motivation letter/SOP, English proof, প্রয়োজন হলে recommendation, birth certificate ও কাজ/স্টাডি গ্যাপের প্রমাণ সংগ্রহ করুন। নামের বানান সব নথিতে passport-এর সঙ্গে মিলিয়ে নিন।
body.en: Read programme-specific academic and language criteria; a guide’s GPA, IELTS or MOI examples are not universal admission rules. Gather your passport, certificates, transcripts, CV, motivation letter, English evidence and, where requested, references, birth certificate and employment or study-gap evidence. Match names to the passport.

title.bn: নথি সত্যায়ন, অনুবাদ ও পুলিশ ক্লিয়ারেন্স
title.en: Authenticate, translate and prepare police clearance

body.bn: Board/university verification-এর পর প্রয়োজনীয় সরকারি authentication করুন। কোন নথিতে apostille এবং কোনটিতে embassy legalization লাগে, গ্রহণকারী কর্তৃপক্ষের নির্দেশনা দেখুন। Apostille, qualification recognition ও translation আলাদা ধাপ। Original, certified copy, receipt ও scanned backup রাখুন। PCC-এর মেয়াদ appointment-এর তারিখের সঙ্গে মিলিয়ে নতুন করে সংগ্রহ করুন; guide-এর পুরোনো fee বা processing time-কে বর্তমান ধরে নেবেন না।
body.en: Complete board/university verification and the required government authentication. Confirm apostille versus embassy legalization with the receiving authority. Authentication, qualification recognition and translation are separate tasks. Retain originals, certified copies, receipts and scans. Time police clearance to the appointment and check current fees and document-age limits.

when.bn: আবেদনের শুরুতে; PCC ভিসার কাছাকাছি সময়ে
when.en: Early in preparation; obtain PCC close to visa submission

body.bn: Official admission portal-এ account তৈরি করে degree ও intake নির্বাচন করুন। Form পূরণ, প্রয়োজনীয় নথি upload, application fee এবং entrance/interview থাকলে সম্পন্ন করুন। আবেদন নম্বর, confirmation email ও receipt সংরক্ষণ করুন। বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় লিখিতভাবে original চাইলে যাচাইকৃত ঠিকানায় courier করুন; নিজে থেকে original পাঠাবেন না।
body.en: Create an account on the official admissions portal, select the degree and intake, complete the form, upload documents, pay any application fee and complete interviews or entrance tests. Keep the application number, confirmations and receipts. Courier originals only when admissions requests them in writing.

title.en: Confirm admission, tuition and refund terms

body.bn: Conditional offer-এর সব শর্ত পূরণ করুন। বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের verified bank account ও invoice মিলিয়ে SWIFT transfer করুন; tuition payment-এর আগে visa refusal refund policy লিখিতভাবে নিন। Final admission/enrollment certificate, tuition receipt এবং scholarship letter থাকলে সংগ্রহ করুন। কোনো agent-এর ব্যক্তিগত account-এ tuition পাঠাবেন না।
body.en: Meet conditional-offer requirements. Verify the university’s bank account and invoice before paying by bank transfer. Obtain written visa-refusal refund terms first. Collect final admission/enrollment confirmation, payment receipts and scholarship evidence. Do not pay tuition into an agent’s personal account.

when.bn: অফারের পরে, ভিসা ফাইল প্রস্তুতের আগে
when.en: After the offer, before completing the visa file

body.bn: Tuition, living costs, housing, insurance এবং return travel আলাদা করে হিসাব করুন। Sponsor হলে সম্পর্কের প্রমাণ, signed sponsorship letter, income/tax/business evidence এবং গ্রহণযোগ্য financial documents রাখুন। বড় deposit-এর বৈধ source দেখান। Bank Statements workspace-এ পরিকল্পনা রাখতে পারেন; ওই হিসাব কোনো ব্যাংক-ইস্যু করা official statement নয়।
body.en: Budget separately for tuition, living costs, accommodation, insurance and return travel. For sponsorship, collect relationship evidence, a signed sponsorship letter, income/tax/business evidence and the financial documents the mission accepts. Document the lawful source of large deposits. Workspace calculations do not replace bank-issued evidence.

body.bn: Admission office-এ dormitory allocation চাইুন; না থাকলে verified long-term rental agreement করুন। Monthly rent ও deposit-এর প্রমাণ রাখুন। Insurance-এর territory, validity, emergency care ও repatriation coverage এবং insurer গ্রহণযোগ্য কি না যাচাই করুন। Arrival ও residence renewal-এর insurance আলাদা হতে পারে। ভাড়া advance দেওয়ার আগে owner ও property যাচাই করুন।
body.en: Request a dormitory allocation or obtain a verified long-term rental agreement. Retain evidence of monthly rent and deposits. Check insurance territory, validity, emergency care, repatriation and insurer acceptance. Entry insurance and residence-renewal insurance may differ. Verify the landlord and property before paying advances.

title.en: Submit the file and attend biometrics/interview

body.bn: বর্তমান checklist-এর ক্রমে original ও copy সাজান। Form-এর সব তথ্য passport, admission ও funding documents-এর সঙ্গে মিলিয়ে স্বাক্ষর করুন। নির্ধারিত centre/mission-এ সময়মতো যান। প্রোগ্রাম, বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়, খরচ, funding ও ভবিষ্যৎ পরিকল্পনা সম্পর্কে নিজের নথির সঙ্গে সামঞ্জস্যপূর্ণ উত্তর দিন। অতিরিক্ত document চাইলে নির্ধারিত সময়ের মধ্যে দিন।
body.en: Arrange originals and copies in the current checklist order. Check form details against your passport, admission and funding records, then sign as instructed. Attend the assigned centre/mission on time. Explain your programme, costs, funding and plans consistently with your documents, and meet any deadline for additional evidence.

title.en: Receive the decision and prepare travel

body.bn: Application tracking ও passport collection-এর নির্দেশনা অনুসরণ করুন। Visa/entry permit-এ name, validity ও entry conditions যাচাই করুন। অনুমোদন ছাড়া non-refundable flight কিনবেন না। Refusal হলে reason, review/appeal deadline ও refund policy দেখে পরবর্তী ব্যবস্থা নিন; অনুমোদনের নিশ্চয়তা কেউ দিতে পারে না। Passport, permit, admission, tuition receipt, accommodation, insurance ও financial evidence hand luggage-এ রাখুন।
body.en: Follow tracking and passport-collection instructions. Check the visa/entry permit’s name, validity and entry conditions. Avoid non-refundable flights before approval. After refusal, check reasons, review deadlines and tuition-refund terms; approval cannot be guaranteed. Carry essential original evidence in hand luggage.

title.en: Register after arrival and arrange residence

body.bn: University enrollment, address reporting ও residence permit application আলাদা কাজ। International office-এর সহায়তায় সময়মতো কর্তৃপক্ষের কাছে নথি দিন। Local bank account, student ID, SIM ও transport pass প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী করুন। Permit expiry-এর আগে renewal, insurance এবং academic progress-এর প্রমাণ প্রস্তুত করুন। অন্য দেশে travel/work rights বা পড়াশোনা-পরবর্তী permission আলাদা নিয়মে নির্ধারিত।
body.en: University enrollment, address reporting and residence permission are separate tasks. Work with the international office and meet the authority’s deadlines. Arrange a local bank account, student ID, SIM and transport pass as needed. Prepare renewal, insurance and academic-progress evidence before expiry. Cross-border travel/work and post-study permission have separate rules.

when.bn: আগমনের পরপরই; মেয়াদ শেষ হওয়ার আগে নবায়ন
when.en: Immediately after arrival; renew before expiry

body.bn: Unaccredited প্রতিষ্ঠান, ভুয়া visa guarantee, personal account-এ tuition, নামের অমিল, unexplained funds, expired PCC, অসম্পূর্ণ translation ও late appointment এড়িয়ে চলুন। Basic local language শেখা, winter clothing, verified student community এবং class attendance-এর পরিকল্পনা করুন। Agent fee optional; সব আবেদন নিজে official portal দিয়েও করা যায়।
body.en: Avoid unaccredited institutions, visa guarantees, tuition paid into personal accounts, inconsistent names, unexplained funds, expired documents, missing translations and late appointments. Plan for local-language basics, winter clothing, reliable student support and attendance. Agency fees are optional; use official application channels.

body.bn: প্রথমে research/English/passport; এরপর academic verification, authentication/recognition ও university application; তারপর offer, tuition, housing, insurance ও appointment; শেষে permit/visa, flight ও arrival registration। Passport/old passports, appointment confirmation, signed form, photos, original admission, tuition receipt, academic documents, recognition/translation, PCC/medical যেখানে প্রয়োজন, insurance, housing, accepted funding, sponsor evidence, SOP ও itinerary চূড়ান্তভাবে মিলিয়ে নিন।
body.en: Sequence: research, English and passport; academic verification/authentication/recognition and admission; offer, tuition, housing, insurance and appointment; visa/permit, travel and arrival registration. Final check: passport/old passports, confirmation, signed form, photos, original admission, receipts, academic evidence, recognition/translations, PCC/medical if required, insurance, housing, accepted finances, sponsor evidence, SOP and itinerary.

when.en: Add each applicable deadline to your calendar

body.bn: Accredited university/course যাচাই করে official portal বা institution-এর linked DreamApply-তে আবেদন করুন। Passport, academic certificate/transcript, English proof, CV, motivation ও recommendation যেখানে প্রয়োজন জমা দিন। University সাধারণত AIC evaluation coordinate করে; board/university verification request দ্রুত উত্তর দিতে বলুন। Authenticity, apostille/legalization ও notarized translation আলাদা requirements।
body.en: Check the accredited institution/course and apply through its official portal or linked DreamApply system. Submit passport, academic evidence, English proof, CV, motivation and references where requested. The university normally coordinates AIC evaluation; arrange timely replies to authenticity checks. Authentication, apostille/legalization and notarized translation are separate requirements.

title.bn: Study agreement, invitation ও residence permit
title.en: Study agreement, invitation and residence permit

body.bn: Offer/Study Agreement এবং required tuition payment-এর পরে university দিয়ে OCMA-approved invitation/reference প্রস্তুত করান। Admission letter, invitation ও residence decision এক জিনিস নয়। Bangladesh-specific embassy route-এ residence form, questionnaire, identity, study purpose, financial evidence, PCC, insurance এবং housing document প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী সাজান।
body.en: After the offer/study agreement and required tuition payment, ask the university to arrange the OCMA-approved invitation/reference. Admission, invitation and residence approval are different evidence. Follow the Bangladesh-specific mission route and prepare residence forms, questionnaire, identity, study, financial, criminal-record, insurance and housing evidence as applicable.

title.bn: Latvia: guide ও official funding page-এর অমিল
title.en: Latvia: inconsistent funding figures need confirmation

body.bn: Uploaded guide €500/month ও €6000/year বলেছে। PMLP-এর পুরোনো study pages-এ €500/€620 আছে; April 2026 general subsistence notice-এ €780 category-ও আছে। তাই একটি অঙ্ককে সব student case-এর নিশ্চিত minimum হিসেবে বসানো হয়নি। নিজের residence basis, permit duration ও dependants অনুযায়ী PMLP/mission-এর written confirmation নিন; tuition, housing ও travel আলাদা budget করুন।
body.en: The guide quotes €500/month (€6000/year). Older PMLP study pages show €500/€620, while the April 2026 general subsistence notice includes a €780 category. No single figure is treated as the guaranteed minimum for every student case. Confirm the applicable residence basis, duration and dependants with PMLP/the mission; budget tuition, housing and travel separately.

summary.bn: ভর্তি, নথি, আর্থিক প্রমাণ, ভিসা ও পৌঁছানোর পরের কাজ ধাপে ধাপে দেখুন।
summary.en: Follow the steps for admission, documents, finances, visa and arrival.

intake.en: Use the current programme/call and appointment deadlines.

title.en: Admission and the correct application route

body.bn: University admission, degree level, full-time status ও start/end dates নিশ্চিত করুন। Uploaded document কোন visa/residence category-র জন্য, সেটি দেখুন। Current official application form, appointment/VAC এবং jurisdiction confirm করুন; checklist-এর পুরোনো website, ঠিকানা বা no-appointment statement-কে current ধরে নেবেন না।
body.en: Confirm admission, degree level, full-time status and start/end dates. Identify the visa/residence category the source covers. Confirm current forms, appointment/VAC and jurisdiction; do not assume old URLs, addresses or walk-in statements still apply.

body.bn: Passport ও previous passport, required photo, signed form, birth/NID এবং civil-status/minor documents যেখানে প্রযোজ্য প্রস্তুত করুন। Name, travel dates ও study dates সব নথিতে মিলিয়ে নিন। Original, copy, authentication এবং translation current checklist অনুযায়ী সাজান।
body.en: Prepare current/previous passports, required photographs, signed forms, birth/NID and applicable civil-status/minor evidence. Match names, travel dates and study dates. Arrange originals, copies, authentication and translation in the current checklist order.

title.bn: Study, funding, housing ও insurance evidence
title.en: Study, funding, housing and insurance evidence

body.bn: Admission/enrollment ও tuition payment বা scholarship evidence সংগ্রহ করুন। Applicant/sponsor-এর funding, relationship/income evidence, accommodation ও accepted insurance প্রস্তুত করুন। Generic travel insurance সব long-stay study route-এ যথেষ্ট ধরে নেবেন না। Source-এর detailed checklist নিচে দেওয়া আছে।
body.en: Collect admission/enrollment and tuition or scholarship evidence. Prepare applicant/sponsor funding, relationship/income evidence, accommodation and accepted insurance. Generic travel insurance may not satisfy every long-stay study route. The source checklist follows in detail.

body.bn: Current checklist order-এ file সাজিয়ে appointment-এ original/copy জমা দিন। Biometrics/interview ও additional-document deadlines অনুসরণ করুন। Visa approval ছাড়া admission-কে entry permission ধরবেন না। Arrival-এর পরে প্রয়োজনীয় residence/registration কাজ সময়মতো করুন।
body.en: Arrange the file in current checklist order and submit originals/copies at the appointment. Follow biometrics/interview and additional-document deadlines. Admission alone is not entry permission. Complete applicable residence/registration steps after arrival.

title.en: Hungary: document groups in the checklist

body.bn: General enclosure: residence form/appendix, passports, flight, exit declaration, insurance, PCC, English birth certificate/CV/motivation। Purpose: admission/status, language, tuition ও study progress। Subsistence: scholarship বা sponsor-এর ছয় মাসের bank statement, financial declaration, relationship ও income evidence। Housing: institute accommodation/lease বা other accepted proof। Healthcare: accepted coverage/evidence। Original ও extra copy set রাখুন।
body.en: General: residence form/appendix, passports, flight, exit declaration, insurance, PCC, English birth certificate/CV/motivation. Purpose: admission/status, language, tuition and progress. Subsistence: scholarship or sponsor’s six-month bank evidence, financial support, relationship and income evidence. Housing: institution accommodation/lease or another accepted proof. Healthcare: accepted coverage/evidence. Prepare originals and an extra copy set.

body.en:
MINISTERIO DE                                                        EMBAJADA DE ESPAÑA EN
               ASUNTOS EXTERIORES, UNIÓN EUROPEA                                           DHAKA
               Y COOPERACIÓN

                                      STUDENT VISA (SLU) -more than 180 days-

   1. TWO APPLICATION FORMS: Two National visa application forms, duly filled out, signed by the applicant. All
      questions should be answered.

   2. PHOTO: Two recent colour passport-size photos with white background (gents with uncovered head). It has to
      be glued (not stapled) on the application form.

   3. VISA FEE: Paid at BLS on the day of submission.

   4. PASSPORTS: Original and photocopy of ALL PAGES of valid passport and previous passports. The present
      passport should be valid for at least the whole intended stay in Spain (1 year recommended). GD copy in case
      of any lost passport.

   5. ID CARD: For applicants over 18, copy of national ID card (smart card).

   6. BIRTH CERTIFICATE: Original birth certificate issued by the registrar’s office in English.

   7. HEALTH INSURANCE: Public or private health insurance, arranged with an insurance company authorized to
      operate in Spain that covers the entire period of stay and all types of healthcare without limitations with the
      same benefits as the Social Security system.

   8. ACCEPTANCE LETTER: Acceptance letter (original letter, both in Spanish and English, addressed to the
      Embassy of Spain) issue by the University/School stating the name of the course, class time as well as the
      opening and the end dates of the course.

   9. STUDIES PROGRAM: Complete program including: subjects, credits, length (starting and finishing dates), and
      name of the Certificate/Grade you will obtain at the end of your studies.

   10. FEES: University/school letter confirming the receipt of the admission fees and enrolment as a full-time student
       specifying the amount paid for the Registration Fees and the Total Fees for the complete course. A bank receipt
       including the payment by the student must also be submitted. For beneficiaries of a scholarship: documentary
       evidence of the amount of the scholarship they have been awarded and details of the covered expenses.

   11. ACCOMODATION: Documentation that justifies the proof of accommodation during the stay in Spain, in which
       the address is indicated.

   12. ACCREDITATION OF PROFESSION: Employers statement specifying the dates of vacation and/or leave (if
       applicable).

   13. EDUCATIONAL CERTIFICATES: Original and photocopy of certificates proving Educational level.

   14. LANGUAGE PROFICENCY CERTIFICATE: Original and photocopy of a certificate of language proficiency (if
       applicant has one).

                                                                      Road 90, House 49, Gulshan 2, 1212 Dhaka
CORREO ELECTRÓNICO: emb.dhaka.vis@maec.es                             TEL.: +88 (02) 8881921-8
                                                                      FAX: +88 (02) 8837252

15. ECONOMIC MEANS: In order to prove that the applicant has the funds/means to defray the costs of stay and
       return, he/she must provide:

                       1)Copy of passport /ID of the sponsor.
                       2)Proof of family relationship with the sponsor.
                       3)Letter of guarantee/affidavit of support from the sponsor.
                       4)Bank account statement of sponsor (at least 6 months).
                       5)Two years Income Tax Certificate and Income Tax Return slip from the sponsor.
                       6)Company certificate from sponsor and salary slip of the previous 6 months (If applicable).

   16. POLICE CLEARENCE CERTIFICATE: For applicants who are over 16: Original and photocopy of Police
       Clearance Certificate issued by each country in which you have had your residence during the last 5 years, duly
       legalized. In Bangladesh, the document is issued by the Ministry of Home Affairs (with picture) and must be
       legalized by ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) and afterwards translated into Spanish language. Only
       certificates which have been issued 1 year before the visa application are admissible.

   17. HEALTH CERTIFICATE: Original and photocopy of a medical Certificate issued by a Bangladeshi hospital
       stating the applicant is “not suffering any of the diseases that may have serious public health impact listed in the
       International Health Regulations 2005.”

   18. MARRIAGE CERTIFICATE AND “NIKAH NAMA”: In case applicant is married, original and copy of marriage
       certificate and Nikah Nama issued by the registrar of marriage and divorce, in English and Bengali.

   19. EXPLANATION LETTER: In case of being unable to submit any of the required documents, separate
       explanation letter for each of those missing documents, translated into Spanish.

                                                                        Road 90, House 49, Gulshan 2, 1212 Dhaka
CORREO ELECTRÓNICO: emb.dhaka.vis@maec.es                               TEL.: +88 (02) 8881921-8
                                                                        FAX: +88 (02) 8837252

IMPORTANT NOTICE

                All certificates must be legalized by the relevant Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) less than six
                 months (except 1 year for Police Clearance) before submission of the application and afterwards
                 translated into Spanish language.

                The whole file must be in A4 format - one side- in order to be properly scanned, a full set of
                 photocopies must accompany the application.

                Documents should be submitted in the same order as in this requirement list.

                Please, note that during the examination of a visa application, some additional documents may be
                 requested in order to determine that all requirements to obtain the visa are met. In some cases, a
                 personal interview with the applicant may also be requested.

                Applications with false or untrue documents will be refused.

                A Spanish translation of all submitted documents is required in accordance to the provisions of Article
                 15 of the Act 39/2015, 01st October, that regulates Spanish Common Administrative Procedures of
                 Public Administration. Translation from English into Spanish is to be done by an authorized Translator
                 (Traductor autorizado).

                Please, note that compliance of the above-mentioned conditions does not automatically guarantee the
                 visa issuance.

                Also note that after receipt of the visa the Authorities may refuse entry into Schengen Area upon
                 arrival. In such cases, the Embassy of Spain accepts no liability.

body.en:
Check-list for STUDY visa (University pre-enrolment)
                   Documenti richiesti per visto per STUDIO (pre-iscrizione universitaria)

     National (“D”-Type) visa application form
     Form must be duly filled in English or Italian, and signed by the applicant (if the applicant is a
     minor, the form must be signed by both parents or their legal guardian)

     Formulario di richiesta di Nazionale (tipo “D”)
     Il formulario deve essere debitamente compilato in lingua inglese o italiana e firmato dal
1.   richiedente il visto (se il richiedente è un minore, il formulario dovrà essere firmato da
     ambedue i genitori o dal tutore)

     One recent photo
     Photo must be ICAO format (3.5 x4.0 cm, color photo with white background, taken within the last
     6 months).

     Una foto formato tessera
2.   La foto deve essere fatta secondo il formato ICAO (3.5 x4.0 cm, foto a colori con sfondo bianco,
     scattata negli ultimi 6 mesi).

     Valid Passport, original + 1 copy
     Passport must be valid for at least 3 months from the date of expiry of the visa's validity. The
     passport must have at least two blank and unmarked visa pages.
     Submit one copy of bio pages.

     Passaporto in corso di validità, originale + una fotocopia
     Il passaporto deve avere una validità residua di almeno 3 mesi dal momento della prevista uscita
3.   dall’area Schengen. Il passaporto deve avere almeno due pagine visti non utilizzate.
     Allegare una copia delle pagine con le informazioni personali.

     Proof or pre-enrollment to Italian University or AFAM Institute
     confirmation receipt of pre-enrolment downloaded from the official UNIVERSITALY web portal,
     with explicit statement of enrolment and tuition fees.
     Include Declaration of Value (DoV) already issued by the Embassy of Italy in Dhaka or the receipt
     of your DoV application (or, where applicable, by another Italian Consulate) OR a verifiable
     CIMEA certificate.
4.
     Documentazione comprovante la preiscrizione all’Università o a Istituti AFAM
     Ricevuta di pre-immatricolazione scaricata dal portale web ufficiale UNIVERSITALY, con esplicita
     indicazione dell’ammontare delle tasse di iscrizione e universitarie.
     Includere Dichiarazione di Valore (DoV) già rilasciata dall’Ambasciata d’Italia a Dhaka o la
     ricevuta della richiesta di rilascio della DoV (oppure, ove applicabile, da altro Consolato Italiano),
     OPPURE un certificato CIMEA di comparabilità e di verifica dell’autenticità verificabile.

     If applicable, assignment of scholarship
     Please note that the assignment of scholarship does not exempt applicants to submit the proof of
     financial means as required at point no. 7 and 8 of the present check-list.

     Ove applicabile, assegnazione di borsa di studio
5.   N.B. l’eventuale assegnazione di borsa di studio non esenta i richiedenti dalla presentazione
     di adeguati mezzi finanziari ai sensi del punto 7 e 8 del presente elenco.

     Language certification (if not already verified by the University with report on Universitaly)
     The certificate must reflect the language in which the course will be held (e.g. Italian or
     English), must be valid (date of issue must not be older than two years prior to the date of
     application for visa) and with a level no lower than B2 (common European framework) for
     Italian and/or other European languages other than English, OR a score no lower than 6 for
     English (only IELTS accepted).

     Certificazione linguistica (se non già accertata dall’ateneo e registrata su Universitaly)
     La certificazione deve riflettere la lingua nella quale sarà tenuto il corso (ad es. Italiano o
6.   Inglese), deve essere valida (rilasciata non oltre i due anni precedenti la presentazione della
     domanda di visto) e di livello non inferiore a B2 (quadro comune europeo) per l’Italiano e/o
     altre lingue europee diverse dall’inglese, OPPURE un punteggio non inferiore a 6 per l’Inglese
     (accettato solamente IELTS).

     Proof of financial means of the applicant
     Personal bank statement issued by any bank operating in Bangladesh covering the last 12
     months, complemented by any other proof of financial solvency (credit card statements etc.).
     Economic availability necessary for repatriation which can also be proven by showing the return
     ticket.

     Documentazione comprovante la propria condizione socio-economica
     Estratto conto bancario personale rilasciato da un istituto bancario operativo in Bangladesh
7.   degli ultimi 12 mesi, correlato eventualmente da qualsiasi ulteriore documento utile per stabilire
     la solvenza economica (estratti carte di credito ecc.).
     Disponibilità economica necessaria per il rimpatrio comprovabile anche con l’esibizione del
     biglietto aereo di ritorno.

     Proof of financial means of the sponsor
8.   The sponsor must be either the applicant’s parents, or an Italian or foreign national legally
     residing in Italy, or Italian Institutions and established authorities, such as Universities and Local

Government bodies, or Foreign authorities recognized by the Italian Government.
      Must display personal bank statement of the sponsor, issued by any bank operating in
      Bangladesh, covering the last 12 months, complemented by any other proof of financial
      solvency (credit card statements etc.). The financial means must be justified (e.g. income
      from salary, ownership/property, non-recent financial products etc.)
      If the sponsor resides in Italy a copy of a valid residence permit must be submitted.

      Documentazione comprovante la condizione socio-economica dello sponsor
      Lo sponsor deve essere un genitore del richiedente, oppure un cittadino Italiano o straniero
      legalmente residente in Italia, oppure un’Istituzione o ente italiano di accertato credito, quali
      università ed enti pubblici locali, oppure enti stranieri riconosciuti dal Governo Italiano.
      Necessario presentare estratto conto bancario personale rilasciato da un istituto bancario
      operativo in Bangladesh degli ultimi 12 mesi, corredato eventualmente da qualsiasi ulteriore
      documento utile per stabilire la solvenza economica (estratti carte di credito ecc.). I mezzi
      finanziari posseduti ed esibiti dovranno essere giustificabili, ad es. da entrate salariali, proprietà
      immobiliari, prodotti finanziari non recenti ecc.)
      Se lo sponsor risiede in Italia deve essere fornita una copia di un valido permesso di soggiorno.

      Where applicable, proof of family relationship with the sponsor
      Birth certificate, duly apostilled by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Bangladesh.

      Ove applicabile, documentazione comprovante la parentela con lo sponsor
9.    Certificato di nascita, debitamente apostillato dal Ministero degli Affari Esteri del Bangladesh.

      Proof of accommodation
      must be demonstrated as follows:
            •      Temporary accommodation reservation receipt (for at least 30 days)
                   OR
            •      purchase contract or rental contract of an apartment;
                   OR
            •      accommodation statement, made in accordance with art. 2 and 4 of Italian Law
                   4.1.1968, no. 15, duly singed by an Italian citizen or a foreign citizen holder of a
                   regular residence permit in Italy, and accompanied by a copy of the ID of the person
                   who signed the statement.
      Disponibilità di un alloggio idoneo
10.   deve essere dimostrata secondo una delle seguenti modalità:
            •      Ricevuta di prenotazione di alloggio temporaneo (per almeno 30 giorni)
                   OPPURE
            •      contratto di acquisto o locazione di un immobile
                   OPPURE
            •      dichiarazione resa ai sensi degli artt. 2 e 4 della legge 4.1.1968, n.15 da un cittadino
                   italiano o straniero regolarmente soggiornante in Italia, che attesti di aver messo a
                   disposizione del richiedente il visto un alloggio idoneo, corrispondente ai parametri
                   minimi previsti dalla legge regionale per gli alloggi di edilizia residenziale pubblica.

      One-way airline ticket booking with Passenger Registration Number or Reservation Number
      and travel itinerary

11.   Prenotazione biglietto aereo di andata con il codice della prenotazione o il numero di
      registrazione del passeggero e con l’itinerario

      Travel Insurance
      Insurance must be valid for the whole Schengen area and cover the whole period of stay within
      the Schengen area.

      Assicurazione sanitaria
12.   L’assicurazione deve essere valida per l’intera area Schengen e deve coprire l’intero periodo di
      previsto soggiorno nell’area Schengen.

      Documents related to civil status of the applicant
      For married applicants: marriage certificate (e.g. “Nikah Nama” for Muslims or marriage act
      for Hindus) both translated in English and apostilled.
      For divorced applicants: divorce certificate (e.g. “Talaq Nama” for Muslims) in English and
      apostilled.
      For widowers and widows: death certificate of the spouse in English and apostilled.
      All certificates must be duly apostilled by the MoFA of Bangladesh.
      ONLY ONE APOSTILLE FOR EACH SUBMITTED DOCUMENT WILL BE ACCEPTED.

      Documenti relativi allo stato civile dei richiedenti
      Per i richiedenti sposati: certificato di matrimonio (p.e. “Nikah Nama” per i musulmani o
      “marriage act” per gli hindu) tradotto in inglese e apostillato.
      Per i richiedenti divorziati: certificato di divorzio (p.e. “Talaq Nama” per i musulmani) tradotto in
13.   inglese e apostillato.
      Per i richiedenti vedovi il certificato di morte del coniuge in inglese e apostillato.
      Tutti i certificati devono essere debitamente apostillati dal Ministero degli Affari Esteri del
      Bangladesh.
      SOLO UNA APOSTILLE PER CIASCUN DOCUMENTO PRESENTATO SARA’ ACCETTATA.

      In case of minors applying for visa
14.   Consent of both parents or custodian if both parents are not travelling together
      Photocopy of passport of parents or legal guardian

Proof of financial means of parents or legal guardian (see point 7 and 8)
      Original birth certificate of the minor issued by the relevant authority
      Proof of adequate protection of the minor in Italy until the age of eighteen.
      The status of “legal guardian” or “custodian” must be proven by documents issued by the
      relevant Bangladeshi Courts for minors
      All certificates must be duly apostilled by the MoFA of Bangladesh.
      ONLY ONE APOSTILLE FOR EACH SUBMITTED DOCUMENT WILL BE ACCEPTED.

      Nel caso di richiedenti minorenni
      Assenso di madre e padre o del tutore qualora il minore non viaggiasse con entrambi i
      genitori Fotocopia del passaporto di ambedue i genitori o del tutore
      Documenti comprovanti il possesso di mezzi finanziari adeguati dei genitori o del tutore
      (vedi punti 7 e 8)
      Certificato di nascita in originale rilasciato dalle competenti autorità
      Dimostrazione di adeguata tutela del minore in Italia fino al compimento del diciottesimo
      anno
      Lo status di “tutore” dovrà essere comprovato da idonea documentazione rilasciata dalle autorità
      giudiziarie Bengalesi competenti per i minori
      Tutti i certificati devono essere debitamente apostillati dal Ministero degli Affari Esteri del
      Bangladesh.
      SOLO UNA APOSTILLE PER CIASCUN DOCUMENTO PRESENTATO SARA’ ACCETTATA.

      For non-Bangladeshi applicants:
      Further than all documents listed on the present check-list, a valid Bangladeshi Residence Permit

      Per richiedenti non cittadini del Bangladesh
15.   Oltre alla documentazione di cui alla presente check-list, un valido Permesso di Soggiorno del
      Bangladesh
